final_answer: Turbine T-4's bearing seal corroded through, allowing seawater into the nacelle—the only pilot failure causing a multi-week outage. Over 24 months the pilot delivered 18.7 GWh to the grid, 6 percent below the original 19.9 GWh forecast. The project finished at EUR 41.25 million against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million (12.4 percent overrun), driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign. Independent fish-monitoring found no statistically significant post-installation change in migration counts (p = 0.41). Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing titanium fasteners with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles, a change the steering group accepted in principle. The steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent on completing the bearing-seal redesign and passing a dry-dock endurance test.
